newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico allows Las Cruces to build substation.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico allows Las Cruces to build substation.

text.p: New Mexico Public Utility Commission dismissed a complaint by El Paso Electric Co, clearing the way for City of Las Cruces to build an electric power substation, the city said Thursday.
El Paso sought to bar the construction by contractor Southwestern Public Service, but the commission cited a lack of jurisdiction over municipal utilities in its decision.
Las Cruces, embroiled in a dispute with El Paso over power rates, has sought for several years to start its own utility, but has yet to acquire necessary distribution assets from El Paso.
In April, the city announced plans to build the substation, allowing it to bring in power from Southwestern.
Las Cruces said it broke ground for the new substation on May 1 and expects it to be operational by January, 1998.
